title: @pool
description: a pool under @pool: its size or its labels, and its strategy; merged over lib/dsys/pool.default.json, then opened by amk.pool. $defs/pool is the open base a pool-like schema extends, closing it with unevaluatedProperties

size.description: how many tokens an unlabeled pool holds; 0 opens it empty, to fill by produce; with labels, it must equal their count

labels.description: one token per label, so the labels set the size; empty for an unlabeled pool

strategy.description: default, also strict or fifo, is resized only by the process that opened it; open is resized by any process and sized by the kernel's count
